about_the_game:
Released by SQUARE ENIX in 2003, Drakengard was a cult classic RPG that not only featured a gripping story but also radiated a sense of "madness" through its music, breaking the mold of conventional games.

The soundtrack that captivated countless fans has finally returned.

*This soundtrack compiles the tracks from DRAG-ON DRAGOON Original Soundtrack Vol. 1 (MJCG-80125), and DRAG-ON DRAGOON Original Soundtrack Vol. 2 (MJCG-80137).
